notes: The DAAD page states no application deadline for this programme ("This programme has no deadline listed."), and no application channel for international applicants is named anywhere; the hs-fresenius.com application-process page confirms the university's own application portal / file upload, but does not name uni-assist. The tuition quote gives a semester fee for non-EU applicants (6,120 EUR per semester); the DAAD page also warns "Tuition fees may vary".

evidence.quote: your English language skills must be equivalent to Level B2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR)
B2 required, please provide an official language certificate, e.g.: TOEFL iBT (before 2026): 70 Reading: 18 Listening: 17 Speaking: 20 Writing: 17 IELTS Academic: 6
